caseNameFull: Louisiana v. Hays and United States v. Hays

opinions.text: Applications for stay, presented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, granted, and it is ordered that the judgment of the United States District Court for the Western District of Louisiana, Civil Action No. CV 92-1522S, filed July 25, 1994, is stayed pending the timely filing of statements as to jurisdiction in this Court. Should such statements be so timely filed, this order shall remain in effect pending this Court’s action on the appeals. If the judgment should be affirmed, or the appeals dismissed, this stay shall expire automatically. In the event jurisdiction is noted or postponed, this order shall remain in effect pending the sending down of the judgment of this Court.
